Subject: RE: Revised SOW + contract redlines (liability/indemnity) — legal analysis

Marissa/Laura — reviewed the attached redlines and prepared a short executive memo (see inline below and attached spreadsheet). TL;DR: recommend escalation to Markus for approval with firm constraints.

Summary of material changes and risk: 
1) Liability cap increase — Orchid proposes 3x fees or $5M. Our standard cap is $1M / 3x fees (whichever is less). Bumping to $5M materially increases open-ended exposure. This is the primary business risk.
2) Indemnity — they request vendor indemnify for regulatory fines and certain third-party claims tied to customer data. We typically limit indemnity to IP and third-party claims; regulatory fines carve-out is high risk and we should avoid open indemnification for fines.
3) Warranty/SLA remedies — they want explicit financial remedies beyond credits for downtime, and a liquidated damages style approach for certain uptime breaches.

Recommendations: 
- Offer a compromise liability cap of $2M (flat) or 3x fees up to $2M, with a conditional uplift to $3M if they accept a price uplift / purchase commitment (12 months committed).
- Reject indemnity for regulatory fines; propose a limited indemnity that covers third-party claims and data breaches caused by our negligence but excludes civil/regulatory fines and penalties.
- Keep SLA remedies as service credits; offer an escalation contact and a 30-day remediation window before credits kick in.

Next steps: we should escalate to Markus for an exec exception that pairs price consideration (discount/credit) with legal concession. Laura — please prepare a short commercial impact note (discount, ARR movement, strategic rationale). Aditya — loop finance to confirm exposure modeling.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Subject: Request for exec exception — Orchid Health (deal ORCH-2026-0421)

Markus — seeking exec sign-off to approve a controlled exception on the Orchid Health SOW. High-level commercial facts: 
- ACV: $430,000 first-year (approx.), projected 18–24 month expansion motion.
- Requested liability cap: up to $5M (Orchid ask). Proposed compromise: flat $2M cap or 3x fees up to $2M.
- Indemnity: Orchids wants coverage for regulatory fines; legal recommends exclusion.
- Proposed concession: 7.5% one-time discount + increased onboarding support; contingent on Orchid signing a 12-month committed term.

Why escalate: strategic customer in payer vertical with potential multi-year expansion and referrer value (they've offered a joint case study). Deal desk recommends conditional exception rather than outright acceptance of open liability exposure.

Attachments: redline_summary_for_execs.xlsx (commercial impact), Orchid_SOW_v3_redlines.pdf

Action requested: Approval to offer the proposed compromise (flat $2M cap OR 3x fees up to $2M; limited indemnity; 7.5% concession contingent on 12-month commit). If approved, Legal will redline new language and I will finalize pricing adjustments.

—Laura Bennett

Team — thanks for the clear packet. I approve the compromise with the following firm conditions: 
1) Liability cap set to a flat $2M (no 3x fees variability).
2) No indemnity for regulatory fines; indemnity limited to third-party claims and data incidents caused by Redwood's negligence.
3) Concession capped at a 7.5% one-time discount and an onboarding credit (not ongoing recurring discount).
4) Require legal to add a mutual SLA remediation clause and a 60-day limit on retrospective claims for incidents reported after contract termination.

Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
